summary: Plan data flows, choose integration patterns, and document controls through practical exercises. Explore the five-day data integration course.
lede: Data integration training helps data analysts, application specialists, and integration leads plan reliable data exchange between business and analytical systems. You practise mapping source-to-target flows, choosing batch, REST API, or event-based approaches, and defining validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and recovery responsibilities. Workshops use sample records and Excel templates to create interface plans and operational checklists; event tools and change data capture are covered conceptually, without requiring coding.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who specify, deliver, support, or govern data movement between business applications and analytical environments. It is designed for people who need to make integration choices and communicate the resulting controls and responsibilities.
outcomes: Pipeline Orchestration With Kafka And Airflow
modules: Batch Integration with ETL and ELT
Event Integration with Kafka and CDC
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with business data and how applications exchange files is helpful. Coding knowledge is beneficial. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; the course uses provided templates and sample files, with no additional software installation or personal platform account required.
